subject: 明代北方客栈，12×9格，灰砖硬山二层客舍附小院（原创扩展；细部待考）
prompt: Use case: sketch-to-render. Transform this exact block into ONE northern Ming town INN, two-storey guest house with a short attached lower side wing and a tiny interior yard behind it. Grey brick walls, hard-gable grey clay roofs with solid flush masonry gables, brown timber upper balcony rails, plain timber double entrance and lattice windows on light left-front facade. No signs or lettering. Realistic finely detailed historical painted game asset, natural muted stone/tile/wood colors. Keep all footprint corners EXACTLY where the guide places them: L200,610 F800,910 R1250,685 B650,385 on1536x1024 canvas. Whole property12m width9m depth, width600px depth450px. Bottom two edges exact slopes+0.5 and-0.5. Do not widen, zoom or change camera; all horizontal edges parallel guide axes, strict orthographic dimetric2:1. Build upward from guide, trim away rear part of volume for tiny yard but preserve external footprint. Thin grey flagstone apron with clear L/F/R outer corners. Architecture fully inside base and canvas with transparent margins. Upper-left light, short soft contact shadow lower right. Opaque building, true RGBA transparent exterior. No people, text, labels, guide lines, thick plinth, scenery, modern items, dramatic upward-curled eaves or baked checkerboard. Keep guest house modest and believable.
